fullDescription: A soft pastel SaaS marketing site on a lavender page with a floating pill nav, a deep-plum hero with a live-canvas mockup, coral and mint hand-tilted italic accents, a playful stat trio, a prompt-library band, testimonials, 2-tier pricing, and a dark footer.

structured.summary: A soft, friendly pastel SaaS marketing website on a lavender page: a floating pill nav, a deep-plum hero card with glowing blobs and a live-canvas product mockup, a trust/ratings row, a feature list paired with a canvas mockup, a playful stat trio, a deep-plum prompt-library band, a 3-up testimonial row, a 2-tier pricing block, a big final CTA, and a 4-column dark footer. Heavy rounded corners, Nunito black weights, coral + mint + lilac accents, and hand-tilted italic accent words.

style.description: Warm, rounded, playful-but-premium pastel SaaS aesthetic: a light lavender canvas with deep-plum feature cards, soft multi-color shadows, big rounded radii, and friendly hand-tilted italic accent words in coral and mint. Extra-bold (Nunito 800/900) headings, generous whitespace, and Phosphor duotone-style icons.
style.prompt: Use Nunito (Google Fonts, weights 400-900, plus italic 700-900) for everything, font-smoothing antialiased. Page background is lavender #f3f0ff. Palette: lavender lav-50 #faf8ff, lav-100 #f3f0ff, lav-200 #e9e3ff, lav-300 #d7cdfb; ink text ink #2c1d4f, ink-soft #4a3a72, ink-muted #6a5d8e; deep plum surfaces plum #1f1338, plum-700 #2a1c4a, plum-600 #3a2866; mint #7be0c0, mint-deep #3fbf99, mint-soft #d6f7ec; coral #ff8a73, coral-deep #f56a4f, coral-soft #ffe2da; lilac #b69dff, lilac-soft #ece5ff; butter #ffd98a, butter-soft #fff2d4; white text on plum uses white at 55-90% opacity. Border radii are large and custom: 4xl 2rem, 5xl 2.75rem, 6xl 3.5rem, plus rounded-full pills. Soft layered shadows in plum tint: soft 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(63,42,110,.28), softer 0 10px 30px -14px rgba(63,42,110,.22), lift 0 28px 60px -24px rgba(63,42,110,.40), plus colored button glows pill 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(245,106,79,.45) and mintp 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(63,191,153,.40). Signature detail: accent words are inline italic and slightly rotated (coral rotate -2.5deg, mint rotate +1.5deg, lilac rotate -1.5deg). Decorative blurred radial glow blobs (lilac/mint/coral at 20-30% opacity, blur-3xl) and a faint white radial-dot grain texture (18px) sit behind deep-plum sections. Icons are Phosphor (Iconify ph:* bold/fill). Mood: friendly, soft, rounded, joyful, never corporate or flat.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column responsive marketing page, max-width ~1180px with px-5 gutters, built as a vertical stack of generously spaced, heavily-rounded sections alternating light lavender and deep-plum surfaces. Sticky floating pill nav at top; hero, trust row, feature+mockup split, stat trio, prompt-library band, testimonials, pricing, final CTA, then a full-bleed dark footer. Most grids collapse to a single column on mobile.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50). Inside a max-w-[1180px] px-5 wrapper, a floating rounded-full nav with mt-4, a white/80 backdrop-blur-md bar, a white/70 1px border and a soft shadow. Left: a 9x9 rounded-xl logo tile with a coral-to-lilac gradient and a white ph:flower-lotus-bold icon, next to a lowercase font-900 'petal' wordmark. Center (lg+ only): pill nav links Features / Prompt library / Showcase / Pricing in font-700 ink-soft with hover:bg-lav-100. Right: a ghost 'Log in' (sm+) and a solid coral rounded-full 'Try it free' button with plum text and the pill glow shadow.

A deep-plum (#1f1338) rounded-6xl hero card with the grain texture, large padding, white text and the lift shadow, plus three blurred radial glow blobs (lilac, mint, coral). Centered max-w-3xl content: a pill eyebrow badge (white/10 bg, white/15 border) with a mint ph:sparkle-fill icon reading 'Now: 1,200+ ready-to-ship layouts'; a font-900 h1 up to ~66px, leading-[1.05], 'Where words and beautiful design meet' where 'words' is the italic coral accent and 'design' the italic mint accent; a white/70 font-600 subhead; and two CTAs in a row, a solid coral pill 'Start designing free' with arrow and a ghost white/20-border 'See how it works' with a mint play icon.

Below the hero copy, a max-w-4xl product mockup zone. A 5-column grid: a 2-col white/95 rounded-4xl 'Your prompt' panel (coral chat icon label, a lav-100 chip quoting a sample prompt, a checklist of green ph:check-circle-fill steps with one pulsing coral spinner, and a full-width plum 'Generate' button) and a 3-col white/95 rounded-4xl 'Live preview' panel (browser-dot header with coral/butter/mint dots, and a lav-50 mini-wireframe with skeleton bars, coral/mint pills, and animated growing bar-chart columns). Two floating accent chips overlap the corners: a tilted mint '12s to first draft' stat card (lift shadow, gentle floaty animation) and a tilted white 'Looks great!' pill with a coral smiley avatar.

A centered horizontal row (stacks on mobile) with thin lav-200 vertical dividers between three proof items: five coral ph:star-fill stars over '4.9/5 on Product Hunt'; a mint ph:medal-fill icon with 'Best of Design 2026 / Indie Maker Awards'; a lilac ph:users-three-fill icon with '57k+ makers / designing daily'. Labels in font-700 ink-muted, key numbers font-900 ink.

prompts.partPt: Recursos e Diferenciais list + canvas mockup
prompts.prompt: A 2-column section (id=features). Centered eyebrow pill (coral-soft bg, plum text), a font-900 heading up to ~44px 'Ship a SaaS site that looks designed, not generated' with 'designed' as the italic mint-ink accent, and a muted subhead. Left column: three stacked rounded-4xl feature rows, the first emphasized with a 2px coral border and white bg, the rest white/70 with hover lift; each row has a 12x12 rounded-2xl pastel icon tile (coral-soft, mint-soft, lilac-soft) with a Phosphor icon (magic-wand, git-branch, code), a font-900 title and muted body. Right column: a white rounded-5xl product mockup with pill tabs (active plum Canvas, inactive lav-100 Components/Brand kit/Export) over a lav-50 canvas holding small rounded design-frame cards (one mint-bordered with shadow-mintp), gradient thumbnails, skeleton lines and an animated bar chart.

A 3-column grid of big rounded-5xl pastel stat cards, the middle one nudged up (-mt-4): coral-soft card '10x faster from idea to a live, on-brand landing page' (number in coral-deep), mint-soft card '1,200+ free prompt-library layouts to fork and remix' (mint-deep), lilac-soft card '5 min from blank page to first lovely draft' (lilac). Numbers are ~60px font-900; supporting copy font-700 ink-soft, centered.

A deep plum-700 rounded-6xl band (id=library) with grain texture, a coral glow blob, centered intro (mint pill eyebrow 'The prompt library', font-900 heading 'Steal a starting point, guilt-free' with 'guilt-free' as the italic coral accent, white/70 subcopy), then a 3-column grid of white/95 rounded-4xl preview cards each with a pastel gradient thumbnail (skeleton content), a font-900 label (Fintech bold / Calm wellness / Dev tool dark) and a coral ph:heart-fill; the middle card is nudged up. Below, a centered mint rounded-full 'Browse the full library' button with plum text and the mint glow shadow.

A section (id=love) with a centered mint-soft eyebrow pill, a font-900 heading 'The website builder that brings joy back to shipping' with 'joy' as the italic lilac accent, then a 3-column testimonial grid. Side cards are white rounded-4xl with coral stars, a font-700 ink-soft quote and an avatar row (coral/lilac-soft monogram circle, name + role). The center card is the highlighted plum variant (white text, butter stars, mint monogram) and is nudged up.

A pricing section (id=pricing) with a lilac-soft eyebrow pill, a font-900 heading 'Start free. Upgrade when it clicks.' with 'clicks' as the italic coral accent, and a muted reassurance line. A centered max-w-3xl 2-column grid: a white rounded-5xl 'Sprout' free $0/forever card with an outline 'Get started' button and a checklist; and a highlighted plum 'Bloom' $19/month card with a coral 'MOST LOVED' ribbon, a mint solid 'Start free trial' button, and a longer mint-checked feature list. Prices ~48px font-900, checks use ph:check-circle-fill.

A centered closing block: a 16x16 rounded-3xl coral-to-lilac gradient tile with a white ph:flower-lotus-bold icon, a font-900 heading up to ~54px 'It is time your website looked as good as your idea.' with 'time' as the italic mint-ink accent, a muted subhead, and two actions: a solid coral pill 'Start designing free' and a text-link 'Talk to us' with an arrow.

A full-bleed deep-plum footer. Inside a max-w-[1180px] wrapper, a [1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr] grid: a brand column (logo tile + 'petal' wordmark, a white/55 description, and four rounded-full white/10 social chips X/GitHub/YouTube/Discord that hover coral) plus three link columns (Product, Use cases, Company) with font-900 headings and white/60 links that hover mint. A white/10 top hairline separates a bottom bar with the copyright and Privacy/Terms/Status links, stacked on mobile and spaced-between on desktop.

special_ui_components.prompt: Floating glass pill nav: rounded-full white/80 backdrop-blur bar with white/70 border and soft shadow, sticky at top.
Hand-tilted italic accent words: inline italic spans rotated a few degrees (coral -2.5deg, mint +1.5deg, lilac -1.5deg) used inside headings.
Live-canvas hero mockup: paired 'Your prompt' + 'Live preview' white cards with a generating checklist (pulsing spinner) and animated growing bar-chart skeletons.
Floating accent chips: a tilted mint '12s to first draft' stat card with a gentle floaty keyframe animation, and a tilted white 'Looks great!' smiley pill, overlapping the mockup corners.
Glow blobs + grain: blurred radial color blobs (lilac/mint/coral) and a faint white radial-dot grain texture layered behind deep-plum sections.
Pastel stat cards: oversized rounded-5xl coral/mint/lilac-soft cards with ~60px font-900 numbers, middle card vertically offset.
Highlighted plum cards: the featured testimonial and the 'Bloom' pricing tier invert to a deep-plum surface with white text, a colored ribbon and glow-shadow CTA.
Phosphor icons throughout via Iconify (ph:flower-lotus-bold, ph:sparkle-fill, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:heart-fill, ph:star-fill, ph:magic-wand-fill, ph:git-branch-fill, ph:code-fill).

structured.special_notes: Keep Nunito at heavy weights (800/900) for all headings and buttons; body stays 600/700. Hold the exact pastel palette (lavender page #f3f0ff, plum surfaces #1f1338, coral #ff8a73, mint #7be0c0, lilac #b69dff). Accent words must be italic AND slightly rotated, never just colored. Use only large rounded radii (4xl-6xl + full pills) and the soft plum-tinted shadows. Keep the friendly, joyful tone in all copy and never use em-dashes. Responsive: nav links and most multi-column grids collapse to a single column on mobile while the floating decorative chips hide; preserve the sticky pill nav and the deep-plum/lavender alternation.
